content.text: {"primaryVerdict":"PASS_STANDALONE","reasoning":"Every canonical target (C3, A2, A1, P2, P1) is established by verbatim text in the standalone stem, and none required a fact that exists only in the now-revealed sibling case. The stem states 'activated MCI mode', 'seven casualties', 'industrial explosion with ammonia release', 'START triage is complete', 'one contaminated red-category casualty has completed decontamination', and 'scarce blood and treatment spaces are being allocated' — which together fully instantiate C3 and directly license A2 (use completed START categories to sequence scarce resources), A1 (decontamination before ED entry), P2 (trajectory of salvageable red/yellow casualties as the outcome of allocation), and P1 (absence of secondary contamination as the outcome of decontamination). All six distractors are excluded either on stem text (C1, C2) or on general MCI doctrine that requires no client-specific data (A3, A4, P3, P4). Applying the fixed precedence: no canonical target depends on a hidden case fact, so FAIL_HIDDEN_CASE_DEPENDENCY does not trigger; no keyed or distractor token rests on an unsupported premise that changes rankability, so FAIL_UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN_PREMISE does not trigger; the 1/2/2 set is uniquely determined with no viable alternative combination, so FAIL_UNDERDETERMINED does not trigger; the canonical key matches the blind Stage 2 selection as sets and the published rationale is internally consistent with MCI doctrine, so FAIL_CANONICAL_KEY_OR_LOGIC does not trigger; and I have no substantive disagreement with the key, so HOLD_REVIEWER_DISAGREEMENT does not trigger. The sibling case corroborates the entire keyed set in fine detail — it names the same two black/expectant casualties, the same decontamination barrier, the same red/yellow/green distribution, and question 6 keys the exact analogs of P2 and P1 while rejecting the exact analogs of P3 and P4 — but every one of those details is confirmatory rather than load-bearing. The blind Stage 2 record reached the identical set without any of them, which is itself direct evidence of standalone sufficiency. The only content observation worth passing to a reviewer is that distractor A4 imports a clinical detail ('a contaminated casualty with stridor') that appears nowhere in the standalone stem and is traceable to sibling Casualty D; this is a token-authoring artifact, not a dependency, because A4 is a distractor whose exclusion rests on the decontamination-bypass principle and would hold whether or not such a casualty existed. This is correct under START, which sorts on respirations first — apnea after repositioning is the black endpoint regardless of pulse — and the sibling rationale states this explicitly. Flagged only because the retained carotid pulse could invite a learner challenge; the key is clinically sound.","severity":"low","affectsRankability":false},{"location":"Sibling stage_3_update, Casualty C","observation":"Urine output of 25 mL in the past hour after four units of PRBCs is borderline-low for an adult and is presented among otherwise improving parameters without comment. The standalone stem's ammonia release plus completed decontamination independently make absence of secondary contamination the direct measure of the hazmat control."}]}
